text:
Priya (Finance): Quick announcement: updated expense policy effective July 1. Manager auto-approval raised to $5k (PO still required), virtual cards mandatory for SaaS purchases <$25k, and all vendor onboarding must use the new form. Details + FAQ link: https://redwood.example.com/finance/expense-update.

Marco (Eng): Thanks. Does the auto-approval include consultant invoices?

Priya (Finance): Yes for consultant invoices under $5k, except capitalized projects. For consulting >$10k Sourcing review required.

Ollie (CS): How do we request a virtual card? I tried the old flow last week.

payments-bot: New virtual card flow live: https://redwood.example.com/procurehub/cards. Virtual cards issued for up to 12 months, note cost center and approver.

Sana (Legal): Reminder: contracts with custom T&Cs or DPA always need Legal sign-off regardless of amount.

Marco (Eng): Any change to the two-quote rule? We have an $18k tool that's single-source.

Priya (Finance): Two-quote threshold still $20k. For single-source under threshold, document the business case on the vendor form and Sourcing will review.

Ollie (CS): Will there be a short guide for PMs/ICs?

Priya (Finance): Yes 1-page cheat-sheet and a short FAQ will be posted tomorrow; also running a 30-min office hours Thu 2pm PT.

Marco (Eng): Nice, ty. If anyone hits edge-cases DM me and I can help triage with Finance.

Priya (Finance): Appreciate it. Please route urgent revenue-impact cases with PRIORITY flag so we can expedite. :thumbsup:
